data.summary: I am an experienced software engineer with 8 years of progressive expertise spanning application ownership, change management, application support, and system administration. For the past 7 years, I have specialized in DevOps, leveraging Azure cloud and modern DevOps tools including Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Prometheus, and Grafana. My proficiency extends to Linux operating systems and incident management using ServiceNow. I bring a holistic, hands-on approach to infrastructure automation, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement in fast-paced enterprise environments.

responsibilities: As a Senior Software Engineer – DevOps at Fuji System, I managed end- to-end Azure cloud infrastructure deployments utilizing Terraform, Azure included DevOps, Azure Boards, and GitHub. My responsibilities provisioning and maintaining cloud resources as per evolving business requirements, implementing CI/CD pipelines, configuring robust monitoring and alerting solutions, and ensuring seamless application testing across development, UAT, staging, and production environments. I actively participated in sprint-based project execution by addressing user stories, automating workflows, troubleshooting deployments, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality, secure, and scalable solutions on the Azure cloud platform.

As a DevOps Engineer specialised in BFSI (Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance) clients at HCL Technologies, at the forefront of transforming traditional financial systems into agile, automated, and secure environments. collaborating closely with both development and operations teams to streamline processes, enhance reliability, and ensure compliance with industry standards and regulations.

DevOps Strategy Development: Developing and implementing DevOps strategies tailored to the unique requirements and challenges of BFSI clients, ensuring alignment with business objectives and regulatory standards.

Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD): Designing and maintaining robust CI/CD pipelines to automate the build, test, and deployment processes, enabling rapid and reliable delivery of software updates and enhancements.

Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Utilising tools such as Terraform, Ansible, and Puppet to provision and manage infrastructure resources programmatically, ensuring scalability, consistency, and efficiency across BFSI environments.

Security and Compliance: Implementing security best practices and compliance measures (e.g., PCI DSS, GDPR, SOX) within the DevOps pipeline and infrastructure to safeguard sensitive financial data and mitigate risks.

Monitoring and Incident Response: Establishing comprehensive monitoring solutions to proactively detect and address performance issues, security threats, and compliance violations, ensuring high availability and reliability of BFSI systems using Prometheus, Grafana,splunk and Dynatrace

Automation and Orchestration: Identifying opportunities for automation and orchestration across the software delivery lifecycle, leveraging tools like Jenkins, GitLab, and Bamboo to streamline processes and reduce manual intervention.

Containerisation and Orchestration: Deploying and managing containerised applications using platforms such as Docker and Kubernetes, optimising resource utilisation and facilitating seamless scalability in BFSI environments.

Collaboration and Communication: Foster effective collaboration and communication among cross-functional teams, including developers, QA engineers, system administrators, and business stakeholders, to facilitate the adoption of DevOps practices within BFSI projects.

Technical Support and Troubleshooting: Providing technical support and troubleshooting assistance to resolve issues and ensure the smooth operation of BFSI systems, leveraging your expertise in cloud platforms, networking, and distributed systems.

Knowledge Sharing and Mentoring: Stay abreast of emerging technologies, industry trends, and best practices in DevOps and BFSI domains, and share your knowledge and insights with colleagues through mentorship, training sessions, and knowledge-sharing forums.

Working as Devops Engineer in Genpact Being Airbnb as client playing a number of key responsibilities integrating the project functions and resources across the product life cycle, right from planning, building, testing, deployment.
Configure & Manage Applications on AWS platform
Setup DevOps infrastructure for Applications
Carry out Deployments & Releases using GitHub, Jenkins(CI/CD), Docker & Chef for all environments
Maintenance & Upgradation of Dev, Test, Pre-prod, Stage & Prod
Windows & Linux Application servers
Manage Application Pods using Kubernetes
Supervise Infrastructure Management for hosted application and services
Render L2.5 Application Support for UPC & Camunda
Execute OS Patching for Windows & Linux servers using BigFix
Update SSL Certificates & Licenses for all servers
Implement changes & upgrades in Database using PostgreSQL & SQL Server Management Studio
Perform Audits on other Applications post Production Release
Ticket Handling using Jira & ServiceNow
Track & Resolve Alerts from Dynatrace, Prometheus, Grafana, PagerDuty,Datadog,logicmonitor

Software Engineer with 3 years of experience working with Tech Mahindra for USA Telecom Giant AT&T being client under role of Production Operations. With ample experience of handling Production issue in real time and maintaining perfect balance among as stake holders for the project.

Committed to 99.99% uptime SLA Compliance
Successfully deployed major/minor Projects in Production
Environment
